# SilberArrows

> Independent Mercedes-Benz service centre in Al Quoz, Dubai. Established 2011. Specialists in Mercedes-Benz maintenance, repair, diagnostics, performance tuning (sole authorised RENNtech distributor in Dubai), and classic Mercedes-Benz models. Genuine parts only, factory service schedules, XENTRY Diagnosis. 12-month warranty on parts and labour. Free collection and delivery across Dubai.

## Mercedes-Benz services

- [Scheduled Maintenance — Service A & B](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/scheduled-maintenance): Official Mercedes-Benz Service A (Minor, oil and filter, fluids, diagnostics) and Service B (Major, adds cabin filter, A/C treatment, wheel rotation, transmission service). Every 12 months or 15,000 km per ASSYST PLUS, follows factory schedule via XENTRY Diagnosis. Service A from AED 972 (SLK/SLC) to AED 3,120 (Maybach). Service B from AED 1,620 to AED 7,080.
- [Brake Service & Repair](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/brake-service): Brake pad and disc replacement, brake fluid flush, calliper inspection, electronic parking brake (EPB) reset and recalibration via XENTRY. Genuine Mercedes-Benz pads, discs and brake fluid only.
- [Air Conditioning Service & Repair](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/air-conditioning): R134a and R1234yf refrigerant service, leak detection (UV dye and electronic), cabin/combination filter replacement, evaporator cleaning, A/C compressor diagnostics.
- [Electrical & Computer Diagnostics](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/diagnostics): Official XENTRY Diagnosis fault scanning, ECU coding, SCN coding, software updates, guided faults, component activations, sensor and wiring repairs.
- [Engine Repair & Overhaul](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/engine-repair): Timing chain replacement (M271, M272, M276, M278, OM651), head gasket work, turbocharger diagnosis and rebuild, full engine reconditioning, oil leak diagnostics, sensor replacement.
- [Suspension & Steering Repair](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/suspension-repair): Conventional, AIRMATIC (air suspension) and Active Body Control (ABC) suspension repair — air struts, compressors, valve blocks, ride-height sensors, ABC pumps and pulsation dampers.
- [Battery Testing & Replacement](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/battery-service): Genuine Mercedes-Benz battery installation with ECU registration via XENTRY (required for Intelligent Battery Sensor and energy-management ECU). Load testing and cranking-amp capacity checks at every service.
- [Tyre Replacement & Balancing](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/tyre-replacement): Mercedes-Benz-approved tyres including run-flats (MOE/MOExtended) and AMG sizes, with TPMS sensor relearn and programming.
- [Wheel Alignment](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/wheel-alignment): Hunter 3D laser four-wheel alignment, approved for AMG and 4MATIC variants, adjusted to model-specific Mercedes-Benz factory specifications.
- [Interior & Exterior Detailing](https://mercedes-benz.silberarrows.com/services/detailing): Single- and multi-stage machine paint correction, ceramic coating (Gtechniq and similar) typically lasting 3-5 years in Dubai, interior shampoo, leather conditioning, engine bay detailing.

## Speciality areas

- Mercedes-Benz AMG performance models (full range including AMG GT)
- Mercedes-Benz Maybach (including S-Class Maybach and Maybach GLS)
- Mercedes EQ electric range (EQA, EQB, EQC, EQE, EQS, EQV, EQG)
- Classic Mercedes-Benz models (mechanical rebuilds, parts sourcing, originality preservation)
- McLaren SLR (one of very few Dubai workshops still maintaining this model)
- Performance tuning — sole authorised RENNtech distributor in Dubai

## Service contracts

- Standard: AED 2,700, 2 years / 30,000 km. Includes 1× Service A, 1× Service B, 1× brake fluid replacement, 1× full vehicle inspection.
- Premium: AED 5,800, 4 years / 60,000 km. Includes 2× Service A, 2× Service B, 2× brake fluid replacement, 1× spark plug replacement, 1× coolant replacement, 1× transmission oil + filter change, 1× full vehicle inspection.

## Frequently asked questions

- Is SilberArrows an authorised Mercedes-Benz dealer? No — SilberArrows is an independent Mercedes-Benz specialist, not a franchised dealer. We use genuine Mercedes-Benz parts, the official XENTRY Diagnosis platform and factory service schedules so your Mercedes-Benz keeps full service-history integrity.
- Will independent servicing void my Mercedes-Benz factory warranty? Independent servicing and repairs can void or limit your Mercedes-Benz manufacturer warranty under typical warranty terms. If your vehicle is still under factory warranty, confirm your position with Mercedes-Benz or your selling dealer before booking. All work performed at SilberArrows is covered by our own 12-month warranty on parts and labour.
- How much do customers save compared with a Mercedes-Benz main dealer? Customers typically save 30 to 40 percent on Service A, Service B and major repairs versus main-dealer pricing, with the same genuine parts and factory schedule.
- Is collection and delivery included? Yes — free collection and delivery across Dubai is included with every service and major repair.
- Do you service AMG, Maybach and Mercedes EQ models? Yes — we service all Mercedes-Benz models including AMG performance cars, Maybach, McLaren SLR, classic Mercedes-Benz and the entire Mercedes EQ electric range.
- Do you offer performance tuning? Yes — SilberArrows is the only authorised RENNtech distributor in Dubai. Genuine RENNtech hardware and software with proper installation and support.
- How often does a Mercedes-Benz need service? Most modern Mercedes-Benz models prompt for service every 12 months or 15,000 km via the ASSYST PLUS maintenance counter. Service A and Service B alternate.
- How much does an XENTRY diagnostic scan cost? Competitive flat-rate XENTRY scan with a written fault-code report and repair recommendations. Call +971 4 380 5515 for current pricing.
- What makes SilberArrows different? SilberArrows is an independent Mercedes-Benz specialist based in Dubai, focused exclusively on Mercedes-Benz passenger vehicles. Our workshop combines dealer-level diagnostics and technical expertise with a more personal, transparent and enthusiast-driven approach.
- What types of Mercedes-Benz vehicles do you work on? We work on the full Mercedes-Benz range, from everyday models through to AMG, Maybach, Mercedes-EQ and specialist vehicles.
- Do you service and maintain the Mercedes-Benz SLR McLaren? Yes — SilberArrows is widely recognised as one of the region's leading specialists for the Mercedes-Benz SLR McLaren, with many of the GCC's cars maintained by our team over the years. Our experience with the SLR dates back to when the model was originally introduced, including team members who were factory-trained on the platform during its early production years. From routine maintenance and diagnostics to complex mechanical, hydraulic and electronic repairs, we have extensive hands-on knowledge of the SLR and its unique systems.
- Do you work on classic Mercedes-Benz vehicles? Yes — classic Mercedes-Benz vehicles are a major part of what we do. From maintenance and mechanical restoration to sourcing hard-to-find parts and preserving originality, we support both collectors and enthusiasts.
- Do you use Mercedes-Benz diagnostic systems? Yes — we use XENTRY diagnostics for fault diagnosis, coding, software functions and guided troubleshooting across Mercedes-Benz models.
- Do you use genuine Mercedes-Benz parts? Yes — we use genuine Mercedes-Benz parts and approved fluids to maintain reliability, performance and long-term vehicle integrity.
- Do you offer collection and delivery? Yes — complimentary collection and delivery across Dubai is included for servicing and repair work.
- Do you offer performance upgrades and tuning? Yes — we supply and install performance upgrades including genuine RENNtech and PowerAi products and software.
- Do you offer service and extended warranty plans? Yes — we offer ServiceCare maintenance plans and our SilberArrows Extended Warranty Program for eligible Mercedes-Benz vehicles, helping customers manage servicing and ownership costs with added peace of mind.
